choices.auto: Automatically select the backend based on the C(ansible_facts.pkg_mgr) fact.

choices.apt: For DEB based distros, C(python-apt) package must be installed on targeted hosts
choices.auto: Depending on O(strategy), will match the first or all package managers provided, in order
choices.portage: Handles ebuild packages, it requires the C(qlist) utility, which is part of 'app-portage/portage-utils'
choices.rpm: For RPM based distros, requires RPM Python bindings, not installed by default on Suse or Fedora 41+ (python3-rpm)

choices.all: returns information for all supported and available package managers on the system.
choices.first: returns only information for the first supported package manager available.

choices.safe: Only redirects doing GET or HEAD requests will be followed.
choices.urllib2: Defer to urllib2 behavior (As of writing this follows HTTP redirects).
